sections.summary: What it is: Pinterest's server-to-server interface for advertisers to send conversion events from their own systems to Pinterest.

claims.text: Pinterest describes the Conversions API as its interface for sending conversion events to Pinterest from the advertiser's own systems.

evidence.locator: overview: interface for sending conversion events; setup and deployment options

claims.text: It enables advertisers to send conversions directly to Pinterest over a server-to-server connection.

evidence.locator: server-to-server description

claims.text: Read together, the documented descriptions present the API as an event-delivery (signal) path; the packet does not describe any bidding, budget or campaign-control function for it.

sections.summary: How it works per the evidence: events flow server-to-server from advertiser systems, authenticated by an access token, and are used by Pinterest for optimisation, targeting and reporting.

claims.text: Conversion events are sent from the advertiser's systems directly to Pinterest via a server-to-server connection.

evidence.locator: overview: interface for sending conversion events; setup and deployment options
server-to-server description

claims.text: An access token verifies that requests are made and sent back to the correct user's account.

evidence.locator: access token requirement

claims.text: Pinterest states the sent conversions are used for campaign optimisation, targeting and conversion reporting.

evidence.locator: server-to-server description

sections.summary: Stated purposes are campaign optimisation, targeting and conversion reporting, with deployment standalone or alongside existing tagging/measurement tools.

claims.text: Sending conversion events to Pinterest to support campaign optimisation.

evidence.locator: server-to-server description

claims.text: Sending conversion events to support targeting.

claims.text: Sending conversion events to support conversion reporting.

sections.summary: Documented prerequisites and entry points: a Pinterest Business account, a token generated via the Conversions page in Ads Manager, setup directly or with a partner from the Set up API page in Ads Manager, and Business Access for accounts you do not own; the packet stops there.

claims.text: A Pinterest Business account is required.

evidence.locator: business account requirement
eligibility: business account and token via the Conversions page in Ads Manager

claims.text: An access token must be generated; it verifies that requests are made and sent back to the correct user's account.

evidence.locator: access token requirement

claims.text: The token is generated through the Conversions page in Ads Manager.

evidence.locator: eligibility: business account and token via the Conversions page in Ads Manager

claims.text: Setup can be done directly or with a partner, from the Set up API page in Ads Manager.

evidence.locator: overview: interface for sending conversion events; setup and deployment options

claims.text: Accessing an account you do not own requires setting up Business Access.

evidence.locator: eligibility: Business Access for accounts you do not own

claims.text: Beyond these prerequisites and entry points, the packet documents no further step-by-step setup procedure.

sections.summary: The evidence names conversion reporting as a purpose of the API but defines no specific KPIs, metrics, attribution methodology or expected outcomes, so no KPI claims can be supported and no uplift should be implied.

The evidence supports co-existence with the Pinterest Tag and Mobile Measurement Partners (standalone or alongside) but supplies no feature identifiers for those products and no cross-platform equivalence claims, so the relationships list is left empty rather than minting ids.
